confidence.note: Most demand and churn numbers come from vendors or blogs; CAC to owner-dentists is unverified. 50 real cold contacts would raise it.

gross_margin.note: About 64% on missed-call volume: Retell ~$0.11/min plus NexHealth $0.10 per API call; heavy clinics push cost past $199.

ltv_cac.note: LTV ~$2,700 (4.7% SMB churn) vs CAC ~$1,500 (estimate) gives 1.8.

pricing_power.note: $199 equals Weave's base plan; low-end AI rivals sell at $49-99, so no premium is possible.

build_effort.note: Voice agent on Retell takes days; booking into a PMS plus HIPAA setup takes months at 10 h/week.

skills_match.note: Developer covers the build; healthcare compliance and B2B sales to dentists are missing.

capital_needed.note: Vapi HIPAA add-on $2,000/month and Dentrix write access ~$10,000 exceed the $2,000 budget.

time_to_mvp.note: A demo is fast, a sellable HIPAA-ready booking agent is 2-3 months at 10 h/week (estimate).

sales_cycle.note: Owner-dentist decides, but trust is low: commenters say dentists only trust other dentists.

channel_readiness.note: No audience or network in dentistry; an indie founder reports 600 messages, 0 revenue (R5: no_distribution).

search_demand.note: 205,088 active US dentists, ~135k establishments; missed calls are a known, discussed pain.

trend.note: Funding wave: Patientdesk $1M (2026-02), Linda EUR 2.6M (2026-02), Newton $3.8M (2025-10).

willingness_to_pay.note: Clinics pay $349-1,199/month for Viva AI and $400-1,200/month for human answering.

free_alternatives.note: Weave plans clinics already pay include missed-call text-back; Smith.ai has a free 25-call tier.

competitor_density.note: 12+ named rivals, 3+ YC dental front-desk startups and 10+ launches in 12 months (R3).

differentiation.note: Being a developer is not an edge here; AutoQuill launched at the same $199 (R3).

legal_regulatory.note: Vendor is a HIPAA business associate: BAAs with every clinic and vendor, plus all-party recording consent in 11 states.

platform_dependency.note: Booking needs PMS write access gated by Henry Schein, Patterson or NexHealth, plus a BAA-capable voice vendor.

market_risk.note: Durable need: 62% of dentists name staffing as their top obstacle (ADA HPI, 2025).

skills.note: Strong on the build, no track record selling to clinics or in healthcare compliance.

assets.note: No audience, data, dental network or customers stated.

interest.note: Goal stated as side income; no stated passion for dentistry.

rules_applied.effect: 10+ look-alike launches, no specific edge: competition 2.0 -> 1.5 (competitor_density 2 -> 1, differentiation 2 -> 1.5)

sam.reasoning: TAM x 50% assumed independent (non-DSO) practices that buy without procurement

som.reasoning: 20 clinics x $199 x 12 at 10 h/week, about 0.03% of SAM

competitors_found.reasoning: Named in research: Weave, Arini, Viva, Dentina, Patientdesk, Kairos, Dodo, Peerlogic, Rondah, HelloPatient, Goodcall, Smith.ai

price.reasoning: The founder's stated price; equals Weave's base plan

variable_cost_per_unit.reasoning: 120 missed calls x 3 min x $0.11/min Retell = $40 + 120 x 2 NexHealth API calls x $0.10 = $24 + $2 number + ~$6 card fees

conversion_rate_pct.reasoning: Cold contact to paid clinic, assumed; one indie case had 0 of 600

cac.reasoning: Ads: $8-15 CPC / 2-5% demo rate / 20-30% close = $530-3,750; $1,500 picked in the range

fixed_costs_month.reasoning: Hosting, BAA-capable tiers, compliance tooling, insurance; $2,000+ if Vapi HIPAA add-on is used

break_even_customers_per_month.reasoning: 500 / 127 = 3.9, rounded up; 16 clinics on the Vapi HIPAA path

time_to_first_revenue_weeks.reasoning: 4-6 weeks to a HIPAA-ready pilot at 10 h/week + 2-4 weeks to close a first clinic

launch_reason: Founder's chosen market; 135k US dental establishments and the price points found are all US.

type_checks.note: SMB SaaS monthly churn 3-7%, median 4.7%: lifetime ~21 months. Normal for the segment, not a killer.
Weave locks clinics with bundled VoIP and 12-month terms, while your product sits on call forwarding: hard to win, easy to lose.

cheapest_test: 7-day pre-sale: contact 100 independent Open Dental practices and 10 dental marketing agencies, offer a $199 founding pilot (after-hours answer + text summary, no booking).
kill_criteria: Fewer than 5 replies from 100 practice contacts by day 7 -> stop
0 paid pilots or signed letters of intent by day 7 -> stop
No self-serve BAA under $300/month from a voice vendor by day 14 -> stop
More than 50% of prospects already use Weave AI or a rival by day 7 -> stop

rescue.change: Sell a lite after-hours answer + text summary (no PMS booking) at $99-199 to independents
rescue.why: Cuts build_effort, capital_needed and legal surface; keeps the no-channel problem
rescue.requires: Retell or similar with a BAA; 100 practice contacts

rescue.change: Specialise in Open Dental practices only, with real booking via its open API, sold through dental IT providers
rescue.why: Fixes platform_dependency and gives a specific edge that lifts R3
rescue.requires: Open Dental vendor approval; 2-3 dental IT partners

rescue.change: White-label the agent to dental marketing agencies that already serve dentists
rescue.why: Borrows a distribution channel (no_distribution) at the cost of pricing power
